name: football-analyst
description: Arabic-first football fixtures, form, goals, corners and shots analysis for Claude.
long_description:
Connect Claude Desktop to API-Football to list fixtures across covered competitions and analyze form, injuries, head-to-head records, estimated 1X2 and goals probabilities, corners and shots inside the box. Projections are estimates, not guarantees.

Requires an API-Football API key.

api_key.title: API-Football API Key
api_key.description: Paste your API key from api-football.com. Stored as a sensitive setting by Claude Desktop.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: Fixture display timezone. Use Africa/Cairo for Egypt.

tools.name: list_matches
tools.description: List football fixtures for a date, with optional competition, country, team and status filters.

tools.name: analyze_match
tools.description: Analyze one fixture using recent form, independent Poisson estimates, provider predictions, injuries, head-to-head, corners and shots inside the box.

tools.name: analyze_today_matches
tools.description: List today's fixtures and deeply analyze a bounded number of selected matches to control API usage.
